chose: member/key extraction re-expressed as holder-paired capture classes (@shape.member+@shape.of, @table.key+@table.of, ...) aggregated by captured node identity
over: range-containment assignment of bare member captures to sites
quantified captures inside the site patterns themselves
because: holder-paired patterns give one match per member with its direct parent captured, so aggregation is a Map by node id — exact direct-child semantics with no positional inference; quantified in-pattern captures explode combinatorially over non-contiguous children and mis-handle comments

chose: old kids() comment-filtering re-expressed as a (comment) @skip capture class dropped by node identity
over: keeping kids() walks in the site mechanism
because: probe showed (_) child patterns DO match comment extras, so alt/item counts and peel/subject first-child picks need the same filter the retired walks had; identity-dropping captured @skip nodes is language-blind (no node-type test in mechanism) and byte-exact with kids()

chose: python compare regexes became four anchored comparison_operator query patterns (name-first/lit-first x chain-start/chain-middle) plus mechanism-side quoted-span and word-run extraction on the captured operands
over: keeping CMP_A/CMP_B regexes on condition text
because: probed: the retired regexes also matched inside 3-operand chains (a == b == "c" yields (b,c)), so chain-middle patterns are needed for parity; quoted-span/[A-Za-z_][\w.]* run extraction on captured node text reproduces the regexes' exact spelling artifacts (a.b().c -> c) while the grammar decides what is a comparison

chose: condition-mode compare keeps the retired truthiness guard: a clause whose winning literal reads empty contributes nothing
over: keeping every captured comparison including empty-string literals
because: gate refuted the first attempt: werkzeug http.py:433 grew a 3-key 'char' chain the retired scanner never produced — its 'if (expr && lit)' guard silently dropped clauses like char == SQUOTE-DQUOTE-SQUOTE whose CMP_A span reads empty, and dropping the clause (not re-picking a later candidate) is the exact behavior; re-gated to 0 deltas over repo+django+flask+werkzeug

chose: what stayed mechanism: typeLinkOf (TS annotation reader), the two-phase peel loop, chain grouping, and the site-assembly policy
over: expressing the peel walk and scope walk as single query patterns
because: arbitrary-depth wrapper nesting and ancestor-scope lookup are capture-inexpressible in tree-sitter (no descendant operator, no recursion); what stayed is language-blind by construction — peel and scope walks consume only @peel.*/@scope capture classes by node identity and range containment, never node-type names; typeLinkOf is the brief's own carve-out and only ever receives @var.type/@peel.item captures no other pack emits. Grammar knowledge that could not move (comment filtering, f-string keys, template substitutions) moved as @skip/@interp/@lit.sub identity-drop classes instead

chose: three retired-artifact equivalences adopted: as-const is the single-named-child as_expression; empty cooked table keys drop in every language; scope-less chains key on -1 in python too (was <module>)
over: reproducing each artifact with per-language mechanism branches
because: measured, not argued: the byte-level gate (site sets over this repo + django + flask + werkzeug, ranked report byte-identical) shows all three at zero deltas — TS has no as-with-one-named-child besides as const, no measured tree has an empty TS object key, and the scope-key spelling never leaves the grouping Map
